note: Sites watched from orbit. bbox is WGS 84 lon/lat [W, S, E, N]. gt/satellite.py renders frames in the site's UTM zone (epsg) on the envelope of the bbox, snapped outward to a 20 m grid, so Sentinel-2's 10 m pixels are not resampled. Each frame manifest records the exact UTM bounds. Checked 2026-10-08.

sites.label: Anduril Arsenal-1
sites.place: Harrison Township, Pickaway County, Ohio; south of Rickenbacker International Airport, between Airbase Rd and Walnut Creek
sites.crs_notes: EPSG:32617 (WGS 84 / UTM 17N), Sentinel-2 tile 17TLE. The crop is 3.4 x 2.8 km: Arsenal-1's two buildings, the W-CTR land east to Walnut Creek, the neighbouring logistics warehouses to the west and the C5 graded site north of Airbase Rd. NAIP 2023 is in NAD83 / UTM 17N (EPSG:26917), about 1 m from WGS 84.

verification.summary: Pickaway County permits name 'Arsenal 1' at 4641 Elizabeth Ave, 4611 Airbase Rd and 4970 Elizabeth Ave. The county's address points put those addresses inside parcels F16-0-001-00-015-25 and -015-26, owned by W-CTR Rickenbacker entities (CT Realty joint venture). Both parcels are bare in NAIP 2023-05-21 and carry two new large buildings in Sentinel-2 on 2026-09-25. Permits at 4641 Elizabeth Ave also name Anduril products ('ROADRUNNER TI', 'BARRACUDA' fire alarm).

parcels.role: 4641 Elizabeth Ave: Arsenal 1 building 'G5' (Phase 1 tenant build-out; 'Arsenal 1 Project Phase 2', 924,352 sq ft new structure, permitted 2025-10-24)
4611 Airbase Rd and 4970 Elizabeth Ave: second building ('Arsenal 1 G5' sprinklers; 'Arsenal 1 Ph. 2' kitchen fit-out)

notes: W-CTR parcels here total about 496 acres, matching the reported 500-acre site. The two building parcels are confirmed by permits. The Scarbrough parcels are attributed by owner group, adjacency and acreage only; no permit names Arsenal-1 there yet. In Dec 2025 the county permitted demolition of houses on three small Scarbrough parcels (10119 and 9959 Walnut Creek Pike, 5487 Airbase Rd).

4641 Elizabeth Ave was already 'Building 5' in the county address layer in Nov 2023, so Anduril took over a CT Realty building pad and fitted it out. 4611 Airbase Rd and 4970 Elizabeth Ave were added to the address layer in March 2026.
Arsenal-1 also has an airside hangar ('Arsenal 1 Airside Hangar Ph 1', 4175 Fury Ct, Columbus 43217). The county address layer has no point for it, so it is not located.
A third-party firearms-licence directory lists Anduril Industries, Inc. at 4641 Elizabeth Ave (type 10). ATF's own list blocks scripts, so this is not confirmed.
lookalikes: The heavily graded site directly north of Airbase Rd (parcels F16-0-001-00-056-00, -056-02 and -057-00, 174.6 acres, near 39.795, -82.914) belongs to C5 Global Connect LLC, not Anduril. The 'active graded site near 39.796, -82.915' in research/feasibility/README.md is this C5 site.
The white warehouses west of Arsenal-1 belong to other logistics tenants (for example TJX 'Sierra' at 4077 Airbase Rd).

sites.label: General Matter, Paducah enrichment site (Leasing Parcel A)
sites.place: Former Paducah Gaseous Diffusion Plant, McCracken County, Kentucky; the wedge south of the fenced plant area
sites.crs_notes: EPSG:32616 (WGS 84 / UTM 16N), Sentinel-2 tile 16SCG. The crop is 3.0 x 2.5 km: the southern half of the old plant, Parcel A, and the forest to the south (Global Laser Enrichment land). NAIP 2022 is in NAD83 / UTM 16N (EPSG:26916).

verification.summary: DOE's leasing data package for Leasing Parcel A (July 2025) describes about 100 acres on the south/southeastern side of the fenced plant (the 'Limited Area'), with Little Bayou Creek under 1,000 ft to the east and Global Laser Enrichment's land to the south. Its Figure 1 shows the parcel as the wedge south of the fence. In Sentinel-2 that wedge is forest on 2025-10-08, cleared by 2026-01-19 and bare graded soil from May 2026. That matches DOE's 'Site Preparation Including Tree Clearing (Parcel A)' exclusion and General Matter's March 2026 soil-improvement filing with the NRC.

parcels.owner: U.S. Department of Energy (leased to General Matter, Inc., 2025-08-05)

notes: The boundary is from DOE's map figure, not a surveyed polygon. The crop is centred on the cleared wedge near 37.1009, -88.8136.
The plant map is drawn to 'plant north', which is rotated from true north.
lookalikes: Global Laser Enrichment owns the land directly south of Parcel A, and a separate 665-acre tract is earmarked for its laser enrichment plant. Clearing there would look the same from orbit.
DOE also has Leasing Parcels B (~785 acres) and C (~188 acres) at the site.

sites.label: Helion Orion fusion plant
sites.place: 1476 Nixon Rapids Ln, Malaga, Chelan County, Washington; west bank of the Columbia, just southwest of Rock Island Dam
sites.crs_notes: EPSG:32610 (WGS 84 / UTM 10N), Sentinel-2 tile 10TGT. The site is 0.1 degrees west of the zone 10/11 boundary, so only zone-10 scenes are used. The crop is 2.8 x 2.4 km: the Helion pad, the existing PUD switchyard and Rock Island Dam. NAIP 2023 is in NAD83 / UTM 10N (EPSG:26910).

verification.summary: Chelan County's SEPA 25-139 notice and MDNS name Helion Energy Inc. as applicant for a fusion generation project on an 80-acre portion of the 401-acre parcel APN 21-22-05-000-050 at 1476 Nixon Rapids Ln, owned by Chelan County PUD #1. The county parcel layer gives that parcel's outline. Inside it, Sentinel-2 shows no disturbance on 2025-05-01, a fresh graded pad on 2025-07-07 (Helion announced earthwork on 2025-07-22), and a building on the pad by 2026.

parcels.owner: Chelan County PUD #1 (Helion is the applicant; 80-acre portion)

notes: The 80-acre project area inside the 401-acre parcel is located from imagery (the pad), not from the site civil plans. The checklist PDF is a scan with no text layer.
Planned buildings (MDNS): ~100,000 sf fusion generation building, 26,800 sf assembly building, 6,240 sf office, 55,000 sf substation, 50,000 sf parking lot and a 1,000 ft private access road.
lookalikes: The fenced switchyard with white structures just east of the pad belongs to the PUD and Rock Island Dam. It predates Helion and is in NAIP 2023.
